definitions.explanation: The two families involved in something, especially the families of a bride and groom.

examples.japanese: {両家|りょうけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔合|かおあ}わせ→顔合わせ：10685_kaoawase⟧。
examples.english: A first meeting of the two families.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{両家|りょうけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親族|しんぞく}→親族：14199_shinzoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Relatives from both families gathered for the wedding.

examples.japanese: {両家|りょうけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{食事会|しょくじかい}→食事会：23547_shokujikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{和|なご}やか→和やか：05704_nagoyaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The dinner where both sets of parents met for the first time went smoothly, if a little tensely.

notes:
Mostly heard around marriage: a wedding is traditionally framed as joining two families, and invitations and speeches name the {両家|りょうけ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {両家|りょうけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔合|かおあ}わせ→顔合わせ：10685_kaoawase⟧: the first formal meeting of both families
- {両家|りょうけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧: both sets of parents
- {両家|りょうけ}⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧: the representative of both families (who gives the closing speech at a wedding)
